blockers: No 5 cm surface probe exists at IITK_Airstrip (only 10, 25, 50, and 80 cm were installed).
The 10 cm sensor in ISMN_surface_0-10 measures at the lower boundary of the 0-10 cm layer and cannot serve as a surface 5 cm proxy.
The 10 cm file is an exact redundant duplicate of the 10 cm file in ISMN_middle_10-30.
Observation window (2011-2012) ended 25 months before Sentinel-1/SMAP and 31 months before Sentinel-2.
surface_0_10cm.verdict: REJECT as surface 0-10 cm proxy; reclassify 10 cm sensor exclusively to middle 10-30 cm target.

middle_10_30cm.data_quality: High within its operational window (100% flag G, physically consistent 0.052 to 0.420 m3/m3)
middle_10_30cm.depth_mapping_method: Dual discrete point sensors at 10 cm and 25 cm. Must not be averaged without explicit vertical weighting.
blockers: Temporal window (2011-2012) has ZERO overlap with Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, or SMAP.
Station is in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh (750+ km north of Maharashtra) with temperate dry-winter climate (Cwa) and alluvial loam, distinct from Maharashtra black vertisols.
Extended post-monsoon data gap of 21 days (504 hours) in Oct-Nov 2011.
middle_10_30cm.verdict: Scientifically valid for reanalysis-only (ERA5-Land) experiments; blocked from multi-sensor satellite fusion.

deep_30_60cm.data_quality: 100% flag G, but contains 46 observations with VWC < 0.01 (min 0.003 m3/m3) requiring calibration check.
deep_30_60cm.depth_mapping_method: Single discrete point sensor at 50 cm depth.
blockers: Temporal window (2011-2012) completely precedes satellite constellation launches (2014-2015).
1,105 fewer hourly records than shallow sensors due to an extended outage in late 2012.
deep_30_60cm.verdict: Candidate for deep-layer water-balance benchmark with ERA5-Land; blocked from satellite feature alignment.

cross_depth_synthesis.ready_for_feature_alignment_verdict: NOT READY for satellite feature alignment due to 100% temporal mismatch with Sentinel-1/2 and SMAP. Partially ready for ERA5-Land weather-only baseline once 10cm duplication is resolved.
